programs.name: MyHome Assistance Program

amount.text: up to the lesser of 3.5% of the purchase price or appraised value with a CalHFA FHA first loan; 3% with Conventional, USDA or VA

programs.repayment: deferred-payment junior loan, payments deferred for the life of the first loan; due on sale, transfer of title, payoff or refinance of the first loan
programs.note: page not reachable directly from our network; terms read from the official page text indexed by search and the CalHFA handbook myhome.pdf

programs.name: California Dream For All Shared Appreciation Loan

amount.text: up to 20% of the sales price or $150,000, whichever is lower

programs.repayment: repaid on sale, transfer or refinance with a share of appreciation: 20% (15% for borrowers at or below 80% AMI), capped at 2.5 times the loan

incomeLimit.text: separate Dream For All income limits, effective 06/30/2026

programs.status: closed to new applications (portal closed March 16, 2026; vouchers drawn at random)
